## Summary (≤150 words)

As of **2026-11-07**, explain affordability, suitability and tradeoffs with inspectable assumptions and a human contact. German evidence identifies economic doubts, funding constraints and building suitability as barriers, but does not prove a particular interface increases trust. [KfW](https://www.kfw.de/%C3%9Cber-die-KfW/KfW-Research/KfW-Energiewendebarometer.html), [co2online](https://www.co2online.de/news/trendreport-waermewende-2025-unterschiedliche-perspektiven-von-politik-und-bevoelkerung-bremsen-waermewende/)

Show annual household costs, complete installed price and the battery’s additional contribution. Explain self-consumption and independence separately. Numerical uncertainty need not substantially reduce trust, but ranges must represent genuine uncertainty. [Verbraucherzentrale](https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/wissen/energie/erneuerbare-energien/lohnen-sich-batteriespeicher-fuer-photovoltaikanlagen-24589), [uncertainty study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32205438/)

Three variants remain our scope constraint, not a scientifically optimal number. Neither animation nor fluent AI explanation has a verified trust benefit for this particular proposal. Test comprehension and appropriate skepticism, not conversion alone.

## Findings

### German survey coverage

| Publisher | Supported finding | Limitation |
|---|---|---|
| **KfW 2026** | Representative household survey identifies economic doubts/lack of funds as prominent HP barriers; advice and ownership correlate with adoption. [Source](https://www.kfw.de/%C3%9Cber-die-KfW/KfW-Research/KfW-Energiewendebarometer.html) | Correlation is not a causal interface result; all households differ from active homeowner prospects. |
| **Ariadne/Kopernikus** | Heating-cost burdens and perceptions differ and relate to policy acceptance. [2024 panel report](https://ariadneprojekt.de/publikation/report-fokusreport-waerme-und-wohnen-zentrale-ergebnisse-aus-dem-ariadne-waerme-wohnen-panel-2024/) | Observational policy evidence, not validated proposal wording. |
| **co2online 2025** | Costs, policy uncertainty and complex funding are reported obstacles; wellbeing and savings are benefits. [Source](https://www.co2online.de/news/trendreport-waermewende-2025-unterschiedliche-perspektiven-von-politik-und-bevoelkerung-bremsen-waermewende/) | Newsletter survey, self-selected and mostly homeowners; not a representative national rate. |
| **BDEW** | Heating survey covers affordability, operation, security and environmental perceptions. [Study](https://www.bdew.de/energie/studie-wie-heizt-deutschland/) | Industry-commissioned; owner satisfaction does not guarantee a prospective installation’s result. |
| **YouGov/Wegatech 2022** | Acquisition cost, suitability and independence appear in commissioner’s report. [Source](https://www.wegatech.de/ratgeber/yougov-studie-2022/) | Restricted online sample: ages25–65, household net income≥€3,000. Do not generalize headline percentages to all German homeowners in 2026. |
| **EUPD** | SolarProsumerMonitor covers motives/purchasing across PV, storage and wallboxes. [Product](https://eupd-group.com/de/product/solarprosumermonitor/) | Public page establishes scope; detailed motive rankings unavailable. |
| **Verbraucherzentrale** | Explains storage economics, oversizing, backup and energy percentages. [Guidance](https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/wissen/energie/erneuerbare-energien/lohnen-sich-batteriespeicher-fuer-photovoltaikanlagen-24589) | Consumer guidance, not a homeowner survey. |

### Fifteen design rules

**Direct** means relevant German evidence; **indirect** means another population/task; **hypothesis** means our interface proposal still needs testing.

| # | Rule | Evidence and boundary |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Lead with this household’s economics and suitability.** | Direct survey relevance; no proven headline effect. [KfW](https://www.kfw.de/%C3%9Cber-die-KfW/KfW-Research/KfW-Energiewendebarometer.html) |
| 2 | **Show installed total before incentives**, with included/provisional/excluded work. | Consumer guidance addresses total costs and misleading drip pricing; itemization’s trust uplift is unverified. [EU UCPD guidance](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52021XC1229%2805%29) |
| 3 | **Use annual net costs as the main comparison.** Label monthly equivalent as annual÷12. | Economic information affects energy choices in an indirect experiment; monthly superiority is not established. [Newell/Siikamäki](https://www.nber.org/system/files/working_papers/w19224/w19224.pdf) |
| 4 | **Separate payback, financing and lifetime projections.** | Intertemporal assumptions affect valuation; disclose horizon, replacement, maintenance, prices and discounting. [Study](https://www.nber.org/system/files/working_papers/w19224/w19224.pdf) |
| 5 | **Explain kWp/kW/kWh at first use.** | Energy-literacy experiments reveal systematic consumption/savings misperceptions; German 2026 prevalence U. [Attari et al.](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2941272/) |
| 6 | **Show both percentage denominators.** | Self-consumption and share of household demand supplied are different quantities. [Consumer guidance](https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/solarrechner) |
| 7 | **Explain battery size through marginal value.** | Oversizing/day-to-night guidance motivates no-battery/proposed/next-size comparison; the exact UI is a hypothesis. [Guidance](https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/wissen/energie/erneuerbare-energien/lohnen-sich-batteriespeicher-fuer-photovoltaikanlagen-24589) |
| 8 | **Show ranges and explain their origin.** | Indirect experiments found limited trust reductions, primarily with verbal uncertainty; ranges do not automatically improve calibration. [van der Bles et al.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32205438/) |
| 9 | **Connect visuals to household actions.** | Disaggregated/normalized feedback improved comprehension in a laboratory electricity study; purchase effects U. [Visualization study](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/09613218.2017.1356164) |
| 10 | **Make static information sufficient.** | Sankey/animation superiority for this offer is U; use labels and a text/table equivalent. [Study boundary](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/09613218.2017.1356164) |
| 11 | **Compare up to three meaningful options with identical rows.** | Meta-analysis found average choice-overload effect near zero with substantial variation. Three is our product constraint. [Meta-analysis](https://scheibehenne.de/ScheibehenneGreifenederTodd2010.pdf) |
| 12 | **Use verifiable social proof.** | PV peer effects exist; a “similar homes” badge does not establish suitable sizing. Disclose sample/matching basis. [Peer-effects study](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/pdf/10.1287/mksc.1120.0727) |
| 13 | **Make assumptions correctable and responsibility visible.** | Advice associations and uncertainty motivate this hypothesis. Show installer/review status; never invent approval. [KfW](https://www.kfw.de/%C3%9Cber-die-KfW/KfW-Research/KfW-Energiewendebarometer.html) |
| 14 | **Keep AI prose traceable to calculations.** | Indirect CHI experiments found explanations could increase acceptance irrespective of correctness without improving complementary performance. Not an LLM energy-offer experiment. [Bansal et al.](https://aiweb.cs.washington.edu/ai/pubs/bansal-chi21.pdf) |
| 15 | **Remove fake urgency and asymmetric choices.** | UCPD guidance addresses manipulative practices; DSA Article25 specifically concerns online platforms, not automatically every installer website. [UCPD](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A52021XC1229%2805%29), [DSA](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX%3A32022R2065) |

**Framing:** use neutral savings language rather than “Sie verlieren jeden Monat …”. Environmental framing research does not establish a universal winning loss frame. This is a pressure-free product decision, not a proven conversion technique. [Systematic review](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0921800921000082)

### Five German messages

Templates only; bracketed values must come from the offer/calculation.

1. **Recommendation:**  
   “Diese Variante passt nach unserer Berechnung zu Ihren Angaben. Wir haben [Jahresverbrauch] und [geplante Nutzung] berücksichtigt. Vor der endgültigen Planung prüft Ihr Fachbetrieb noch [offene Punkte].”

2. **Costs:**  
   “Die Anlage kostet insgesamt [Gesamtpreis] einschließlich [enthaltene Arbeiten]. Eine mögliche Förderung zeigen wir getrennt. Unter den aufgeführten Annahmen sinken Ihre jährlichen Energiekosten voraussichtlich um [Spanne]. Das ist eine Schätzung, keine Garantie.”

3. **Battery:**  
   “Der Speicher verschiebt Solarstrom vom Tag in den Abend. Die nächstgrößere Batterie kostet [Mehrpreis] zusätzlich und spart in unserer Berechnung weitere [Zusatznutzen] pro Jahr. Sie können beide Größen vergleichen.”

4. **Percentages:**  
   “So viel Ihres Strombedarfs decken Sie mit Ihrem eigenen Solarstrom: [Anteil]. Von Ihrem erzeugten Solarstrom nutzen Sie selbst [anderer Anteil]. Das sind zwei verschiedene Anteile.”

5. **Control:**  
   “Sie müssen sich jetzt nicht entscheiden. Prüfen Sie die Annahmen oder senden Sie Ihrem Fachbetrieb eine Frage. Wenn sich Ihre Pläne ändern, kann der Fachbetrieb die Auslegung anpassen.”

The storage/percentage explanations follow [Verbraucherzentrale guidance](https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/wissen/energie/erneuerbare-energien/lohnen-sich-batteriespeicher-fuer-photovoltaikanlagen-24589); the wording itself is proposed copy.

### Ten homeowner questions and honest response patterns

These are priority hypotheses, not a measured ranking.

| Question | Answer pattern |
|---|---|
| **“Wird mir zu viel verkauft?”** | “Wir vergleichen Mehrpreis und zusätzlichen Nutzen unter denselben Annahmen.” |
| **“Lohnt sich die Batterie?”** | “Vergleichen Sie ohne/mit Speicher: Mehrpreis, zusätzliche Einsparung, Verluste und angenommene Lebensdauer.” |
| **“Funktioniert die Wärmepumpe hier?”** | “Wenige Angaben reichen noch nicht zur endgültigen Bestätigung. Ihr Fachbetrieb prüft [offene Gebäudedaten].” |
| **“Was zahle ich insgesamt?”** | “Hier stehen Gesamtpreis, enthaltene Arbeiten und ungeklärte Zusatzarbeiten; Förderung/Finanzierung getrennt.” |
| **“Sind die Einsparungen garantiert?”** | “Nein. Verbrauch, Wetter, Preise und Annahmen beeinflussen die Schätzung.” |
| **“Bin ich unabhängig?”** | “Der Jahresanteil eigenen Solarstroms bedeutet keine ganzjährige Netzunabhängigkeit.” |
| **“Habe ich bei Stromausfall Strom?”** | “Nur mit geeigneten Komponenten und Installation. Hier steht, welche Stromkreise versorgt werden.” |
| **“Welche Förderung ist sicher?”** | “Wir unterscheiden mögliche und bestätigte Förderung; Voraussetzungen und Antragsstatus werden geprüft.” |
| **“Was passiert bei EV, mehr Verbrauch oder Defekt?”** | “Wir berechnen geänderte Nutzung separat. Garantie, Austauschbarkeit und Service folgen den konkreten Unterlagen.” |
| **“Hat eine KI entschieden?”** | “Größen/Zahlen stammen aus ausgewiesenen Berechnungen. Automatische Erläuterungen ersetzen keine fachliche Prüfung; der tatsächliche Prüfstatus ist sichtbar.” |

These patterns address the barriers and limitations documented above; they are not factual answers about a particular offer.

## Implications for our product

- Prioritize total price, annual costs and suitability assumptions.
- Build battery marginal-value comparison before decorative metrics.
- Explain both percentage denominators.
- Display only engine-supported ranges.
- Keep one clear default visual; technical detail on demand.
- Preserve deferral and human contact.
- Show calculation and review status.
- Test comprehension and whether users notice an incorrect explanation.

## Open questions / uncertainty

- No checked study validates this exact German preview.
- German 2026 unit-confusion prevalence remains U.
- Monthly/annual framing and chart choice require product testing.
- Social proof can encourage adoption without improving sizing judgment.
- AI-explanation results are indirect.
- DSA applicability depends on service structure; no legal determination is made.
- Copy requires consistency with actual components, contract and calculations.
